plan: A thunder bear who charges at his target, stuns it and dives under turrets by disabling them.
aSurveiller: His R (Stormbringer). He leaps onto you and disables nearby turrets: your turret won't protect you.
contrer: Don't count on your turret when he has his R: he can disable it.
His Q stuns you on the first hit: back off when he charges at you.
Avoid long duels: he heals with his W.
forces: Very strong in the early game.
faiblesses: Few ways to close the gap.
Weak in the late game if he doesn't get ahead.

sorts.P: His attacks get faster and faster and hit around him.
sorts.Q: Gains speed, and his next attack stuns.
sorts.W: Bite; the second one on the same target heals him.
sorts.E: Lightning that slows and gives him a shield.
sorts.R: Leaps, gains health and disables nearby turrets.

momentFort: Very strong in duels early: from level 3, he ganks relentlessly. Place wards to see him coming.
